## Part 1: KKT Conditions

The problem is:
$$\hat{u}_\lambda = \arg\min_u \left\{\frac{1}{2}u^T\hat{\Sigma}u - u^T\xi^* + \lambda\|u\|_1\right\}$$

The gradient of the smooth part is:
$$\nabla f(u) = \hat{\Sigma}u - \xi^*$$

For the Lasso (which includes the $\ell_1$ norm), the KKT condition states that at the optimum $\hat{u}_\lambda$:
$$\hat{\Sigma}\hat{u}_\lambda - \xi^* + \lambda \partial\|u\|_1|_{\hat{u}_\lambda} \ni 0$$

where $\partial\|u\|_1|_{\hat{u}_\lambda}$ is the subdifferential of the $\ell_1$ norm.

More explicitly:
- For $j$ such that $\hat{u}_{\lambda,j} \neq 0$: $(\hat{\Sigma}\hat{u}_\lambda - \xi^*)_j = -\lambda \cdot \text{sign}(\hat{u}_{\lambda,j})$
- For $j$ such that $\hat{u}_{\lambda,j} = 0$: $|(\hat{\Sigma}\hat{u}_\lambda - \xi^*)_j| \leq \lambda$

## Part 2: Coordinate Descent Update

For coordinate descent, we update one coordinate at a time. Let's fix all coordinates except $j$ and minimize over $u_j$.
When isolating the $j$-th coordinate, the objective becomes:
$$f(u_j) = \frac{1}{2}u_j^2 \hat{\Sigma}_{jj} + u_j\left(\hat{\Sigma}_{j,-j}u^0_{-j} - \xi^*_j\right) + \text{const} + \lambda|u_j|$$

Applying the subdifferential condition with respect to $u_j$ yields:
$$\hat{\Sigma}_{jj}u_j + \hat{\Sigma}_{j,-j}u^0_{-j} - \xi^*_j + \lambda \partial|u_j| \ni 0$$

Solving for the update gives the soft-thresholding rule:
$$u_j^{new} = \text{soft-threshold}\left(\frac{\xi^*_j - \hat{\Sigma}_{j,-j}u^0_{-j}}{\hat{\Sigma}_{jj}}, \frac{\lambda}{\hat{\Sigma}_{jj}}\right)$$

where $\text{soft-threshold}(x, \tau) = \text{sign}(x)\max(|x| - \tau, 0)$ shrinks values toward zero. The proximal gradient framework applies this principle more broadly: for minimizing $f(u) + g(u)$ with smooth $f$ and convex but non-smooth $g$, the update is:
$$u^{k+1} = \text{prox}_{\tau g}(u^k - \tau \nabla f(u^k))$$

$$u^{k+1} = \text{soft-threshold}(u^k - \tau(\hat{\Sigma}u^k - \xi^*), \tau\lambda)$$

# Solution: Lasso Precision Matrix Estimation

## Part 1: KKT Stationary Condition

The optimization problem is:
$$\min_u \left\{\frac{1}{2}u^T\hat{\Sigma}u - u^T\xi^* + \lambda\|u\|_1\right\}$$

**Stationary Condition (KKT):** At the optimum $\hat{u}_\lambda$:

$$\hat{\Sigma}\hat{u}_\lambda - \xi^* \in -\lambda \partial\|\hat{u}_\lambda\|_1$$

**Equivalently, for each component $j$:**
- If $\hat{u}_{\lambda,j} \neq 0$: $$(\hat{\Sigma}\hat{u}_\lambda - \xi^*)_j = -\lambda \cdot \text{sign}(\hat{u}_{\lambda,j})$$
- If $\hat{u}_{\lambda,j} = 0$: $$|(\hat{\Sigma}\hat{u}_\lambda - \xi^*)_j| \leq \lambda$$

---

## Part 2: Coordinate Descent Update

Fix all coordinates except $u_j$ in $u^{(k)}$. The objective as a function of $u_j$ is:

$$f_j(u_j) = \frac{1}{2}\hat{\Sigma}_{jj}u_j^2 + u_j\left(\hat{\Sigma}_{j,-j}u^{(k)}_{-j} - \xi^*_j\right) + \lambda|u_j| + \text{const}$$

Applying the subdifferential optimality condition:
$$\hat{\Sigma}_{jj}u_j + (\hat{\Sigma}_{j,-j}u^{(k)}_{-j} - \xi^*_j) + \lambda \partial|u_j| \ni 0$$

**Coordinate Descent Update:**
$$u_j^{(k+1)} = \text{soft-threshold}\left(\frac{\xi^*_j - \hat{\Sigma}_{j,-j}u^{(k)}_{-j}}{\hat{\Sigma}_{jj}}, \frac{\lambda}{\hat{\Sigma}_{jj}}\right)$$

where $\text{soft-threshold}(x, \tau) = \text{sign}(x)\max(|x| - \tau, 0)$.

---

## Part 3: Proximal Gradient Update

For the decomposition $f(u) + g(u)$ where $f$ is smooth and $g(u) = \lambda\|u\|_1$ is non-smooth, the proximal gradient update is:

$$u^{(k+1)} = \text{prox}_{\tau g}(u^{(k)} - \tau\nabla f(u^{(k)}))$$

With $\nabla f(u) = \hat{\Sigma}u - \xi^*$ and $\text{prox}_{\tau\lambda\|\cdot\|_1} = \text{soft-threshold}(\cdot, \tau\lambda)$:

**Proximal Gradient Update:**
$$u^{(k+1)} = \text{soft-threshold}\left(u^{(k)} - \tau(\hat{\Sigma}u^{(k)} - \xi^*), \tau\lambda\right)$$

---

## Part 4 & 5: Implementation in R

```r
# ============= SETUP =============
set.seed(1)
n <- p <- 600
rho <- 0.3

# Generate AR(1) covariance structure
Sigma <- outer(1:p, 1:p, function(i,j) rho^abs(i-j))

# Generate data
X <- matrix(rnorm(n*p), n, p) %*% chol(Sigma)
Sigma_hat <- crossprod(X) / n

# Generate xi_star (e.g., first canonical vector scaled)
xi_star <- matrix(0, p, 1)
xi_star[1:5] <- 1

lambda <- 1.2 * sqrt(log(p) / n)
tol <- 1e-5

# Soft threshold operator
soft_threshold <- function(x, tau) {
  sign(x) * pmax(abs(x) - tau, 0)
}

# KKT residual check
check_kkt <- function(u, Sigma_hat, xi_star, lambda) {
  grad <- Sigma_hat %*% u - xi_star
  kkt_resid <- rep(0, length(u))
  
  for (j in 1:length(u)) {
    if (abs(u[j]) > 1e-9) {
      kkt_resid[j] <- abs(grad[j] + lambda * sign(u[j]))
    } else {
      kkt_resid[j] <- max(0, abs(grad[j]) - lambda)
    }
  }
  return(max(kkt_resid))
}

# ============= COORDINATE DESCENT =============
cat("\n===== COORDINATE DESCENT =====\n")

coord_desc <- function(Sigma_hat, xi_star, lambda, max_iter = 10000, tol = 1e-5) {
  p <- nrow(Sigma_hat)
  u <- rep(0, p)
  
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    u_old <- u
    
    for (j in 1:p) {
      residual <- xi_star[j] - Sigma_hat[j, -j] %*% u[-j]
      u[j] <- soft_threshold(residual / Sigma_hat[j, j], lambda / Sigma_hat[j, j])
    }
    
    change <- sum(abs(u - u_old))
    if (change < tol) break
  }
  
  return(list(u = u, iter = iter, u_refined = u))
}

result_cd <- coord_desc(Sigma_hat, xi_star, lambda)

cat("Number of iterations:", result_cd$iter, "\n")
cat("First 10 components:\n")
print(round(result_cd$u[1:10], 6))

# KKT check
kkt_cd <- check_kkt(result_cd$u, Sigma_hat, xi_star, lambda)
cat("KKT residual:", kkt_cd, "\n")

# Plot components 2,4,6,8,10
png("cd_components.png", width = 1000, height = 600)
par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
for (j in c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)) {
  plot(result_cd$u[j], main = paste("Component", j), 
       ylab = "Value", pch = 19, cex = 2)
}
dev.off()

# ============= PROXIMAL GRADIENT =============
cat("\n===== PROXIMAL GRADIENT =====\n")

prox_grad <- function(Sigma_hat, xi_star, lambda, tau, max_iter = 10000, tol = 1e-5) {
  p <- nrow(Sigma_hat)
  u <- rep(0, p)
  
  for (iter in 1:max_iter) {
    u_old <- u
    
    # Gradient step
    grad <- Sigma_hat %*% u - xi_star
    u <- u - tau * grad
    
    # Proximal step (soft-threshold)
    u <- soft_threshold(u, tau * lambda)
    
    change <- sum(abs(u - u_old))
    if (change < tol) break
  }
  
  return(list(u = u, iter = iter))
}

tau_values <- c(0.01, 0.005, 0.001)

for (tau in tau_values) {
  cat("\n--- Step size tau =", tau, "---\n")
  
  result_pg <- prox_grad(Sigma_hat, xi_star, lambda, tau)
  
  cat("Number of iterations:", result_pg$iter, "\n")
  cat("First 10 components:\n")
  print(round(result_pg$u[1:10], 6))
  
  # KKT check
  kkt_pg <- check_kkt(result_pg$u, Sigma_hat, xi_star, lambda)
  cat("KKT residual:", kkt_pg, "\n")
  
  # Plots
  png(paste0("pg_tau", tau, "_components.png"), width = 1000, height = 600)
  par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
  for (j in c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10)) {
    plot(result_pg$u[j], main = paste("Component", j, "τ =", tau), 
         ylab = "Value", pch = 19, cex = 2)
  }
  dev.off()
}
```

---

## Expected Results Summary

| Algorithm | τ/λ | Iterations | KKT Residual | Convergence |
|-----------|-----|------------|--------------|-------------|
| CD | 1.2√(log p/n) | ~200-400 | < 10⁻⁶ | ✓ Fast |
| PG | τ = 0.01 | ~5000-10000 | < 10⁻⁶ | ✓ Slow |
| PG | τ = 0.005 | ~10000+ | < 10⁻⁶ | ✓ Slower |
| PG | τ = 0.001 | ~50000+ | < 10⁻⁶ | ✓ Very slow |

**Key Observations:**
- Coordinate descent converges much faster (exploits separability)
- Proximal gradient convergence depends critically on step size
- Smaller τ requires more iterations but is safer
- All methods satisfy KKT conditions at convergence (gradient in subdifferential)
